mapper.select: SELECT s.*, a.title AS activityTitle, a.start_time AS activityStartTime, a.address AS activityAddress FROM act_signup s LEFT JOIN ich_activity a ON a.id = s.activity_id AND a.deleted = 0 WHERE s.deleted = 0 AND s.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY s.signup_time DESC, s.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM act_signup s WHERE s.deleted = 0 AND s.user_id = #{userId}
